policy: This POC loads no generative language model, with one narrow, bounded exception recorded in FORBIDDEN.md: a small local FLAN-T5/T5 checkpoint, rewriter role only, fidelity-gated. See bounded_rewriter_exception below. Every other component stays non-generative.

substitutes.embeddings: sklearn TfidfVectorizer cosine (in place of bge-small-en-v1.5)
substitutes.sparse_retrieval: in-process Okapi BM25 (in place of Qdrant sparse / SPLADE)
substitutes.reranker: lexical coverage cross-score (in place of bge-reranker-v2-m3)
substitutes.ask_classifier: feature rules (in place of zero-shot DeBERTa NLI)
substitutes.entity_tagging: rule tagger plus a stricter second rule tagger (in place of GLiNER and dslim/bert-base-NER)
substitutes.address_parsing: regex field parser (in place of libpostal)
substitutes.extractive_qa: two lexical span extractors (in place of DeBERTa/RoBERTa SQuAD2)
substitutes.nli: polarity, number, and coverage judge (in place of DeBERTa-v3 MNLI)
substitutes.pair_matcher: logistic regression over string and context features
substitutes.rewriter: deterministic assembly of verified findings is still the default and the fallback; a small local FLAN-T5/T5 checkpoint is allowed only under the bounded_rewriter_exception below, and only once it has actually been loaded and measured
substitutes.proposer: not used; template analyzer plus grounding filter only

bounded_rewriter_exception.status: policy change recorded 2026-10-14 in FORBIDDEN.md; not yet implemented or measured
bounded_rewriter_exception.allowed_role: rewriter only (ARCHITECTURE.md section 3.7): join and grammar-correct already-verified findings into prose
bounded_rewriter_exception.still_forbidden_for_this_checkpoint: proposer role, extraction, answering, support/contradiction judging, any role that could assert a new fact
bounded_rewriter_exception.blocker: huggingface.co is blocked by this sandbox's egress policy, so flan-t5-small cannot be downloaded here yet. See lab/common/real_models.py for the same block affecting bge/DeBERTa/GLiNER.
bounded_rewriter_exception.required_guardrail: every rewrite must pass the fidelity check (numbers/dates/names preserved, modals unchanged, bidirectional entailment, citations preserved) or fall back to the unchanged lab/common/assemble.py output

real_model_reruns.note: EXP-025, EXP-029, EXP-032, and EXP-033 only. Every other exploration above still ran the classical substitutes in 'substitutes'.
real_model_reruns.huggingface_co_blocked: This sandbox's egress policy denies huggingface.co (403 CONNECT, policy denial), so bge-small-en-v1.5, DeBERTa-v3, and GLiNER cannot be downloaded here. See lab/common/real_models.py.
real_model_reruns.embeddings: spaCy en_core_web_md static word vectors (GloVe-style, real pretrained, not downloaded from huggingface.co) in place of TF-IDF, for EXP-029 and EXP-032's dense retrieval leg
real_model_reruns.entity_tagging: spaCy en_core_web_sm NER (CNN tagger trained on OntoNotes 5, real pretrained) in place of the rule tagger, for EXP-032 and EXP-033
real_model_reruns.not_the_blueprint_checkpoint: spaCy's pipelines are real, reachable, non-generative pretrained models, but they are not bge-small-en-v1.5, deepset/deberta-v3-base-squad2, or GLiNER. Do not cite EXP-029/032/033 numbers as bge, DeBERTa, or GLiNER results.
